{{Top|leg}}
The '''Southern Reservoir''' was a large [[Water/Legends|water]] reservoir on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Darkknell/Legends|Darkknell]] during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. It was located within the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] [[Xakrea]] and was situated nearby [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]]'s fortress of [[Sanctum Celestial]]. During the [[Battle of Darkknell]] in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], the rain and floods that were artificially unleashed by [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Zodoh]]'s [[Stormdriver]]s caused the reservoir to burst its banks, flooding Daiman's palace.
